companionBody: {{appName}} is home to little desktop companions called spriglets. Meet Mallow, the soft lavender spriglet coming soon.
supportIntro: A little help for you and your spriglet.
privacyIntro: Quiet company, with your privacy in mind.

home.description: Meet Mallow, your first spriglet. A soft lavender desktop companion that quietly peeks beneath your Mac’s notch while you work.
home.heroBody: Little desktop companions that blink, breathe, and keep you quiet company while you work.
home.posterEmphasis: When you want to play, it’s soft, light, and lands on its feet.
home.peekBody: Rests beneath your notch with its face showing, blinking and breathing beside your work.
home.playBody: Invite it out, pick it up, let it go. It lands softly, or catches the notch on its way home.
home.waitBody: Long, quiet pauses. Empty space around it clicks straight through to your work.
home.fieldEyebrow: A field guide to spriglets · Volume I
home.fieldBody: Spriglets are small, soft creatures that live at the top of your screen. Each has its own shape and habits. We’re starting with Mallow; more spriglets are planned.
home.plateCaption: Catalogued October 2026, beneath a MacBook notch
home.mallowDescription: Soft, lavender, and a little shy. Rests beneath the notch with only its face showing, blinking and breathing beside your work. Comes out when invited.
home.habitatValue: Beneath the notch; upper right on displays without one.
home.eyesBody: Wide when curious. Sleepy when it’s quiet.
home.crownBody: Rises and falls with each breath.
home.handsBody: Grip the notch’s edge when invited out.
home.feetBody: Small, steady, and ready for a soft landing.
home.keepingIntro: In the current app’s native Settings
home.homeValue: The notch, or the top left, center, or right of any display.
home.hoursValue: Optional launch at login, if you like.
home.quietBody: Spriglets live entirely on your Mac. There is nothing to sign up for and nothing sent anywhere by the app. Mallow stays at its small resting peek until you invite it out.
home.localBody: No account, app server, analytics, or screen capture.
home.gentleBody: Respects Reduce Motion, Low Power Mode, and display sleep.
home.spaceBody: Clicks pass through empty space. Hide or pause in Settings.
home.websitePrivacy: Website hosting is covered separately in the policy.
home.bringBody: A little companion for your Apple silicon Mac, running macOS 26 or later.
home.storeAction: Get on the Mac App Store
home.storeAvailability: Available on the Mac App Store.
home.bringAnnotation: then look up at your notch ↑
home.footerNote: Spriglet is a native, local app. Mallow is original artwork, drawn in code.
